coordinates: X across the panel; Y above the panel underside; Z along the panel, negative toward the printer exit (rear), positive toward Q0 (front). One scene unit is one millimetre. The wiring plan projects the same X/Z positions with rear at the top. Dimensions below are X × Y × Z unless noted.

parts.name: Hammond PCJ16148CC
parts.note: Overall bounds of the supplied STEP assembly, including feet and moulded projections. The nominal 16 × 14 × 8 in catalog size is not its maximum outside envelope. Factory case geometry is retained; proposed openings are location markers, not machined holes.

parts.name: 14R1513 mounting panel
parts.note: Panel and fixing screws from the enclosure STEP assembly. The drawing gives 12.88 × 14.75 in and 0.075 in steel thickness. Electrical bonding is separate from the mounting screws.

parts.name: DENT ELITEpro XC
parts.note: Long blue body uses the current 216 × 63 × 47 mm specification. The older ELOG manual gives 203 × 69 × 58 mm. Measure the photographed instrument before finalizing. Ports, feet and grip details are visual approximations; plug space is additional.

parts.name: CT1 · printer hot only
parts.note: DENT HSC mini hinged example, Ø10.2 mm aperture. Its catalog envelope illustrates the white split-core style in the photos; this does not identify your CT model or range. One hot conductor passes through once; arrow points toward output.

parts.name: Q0 · single operating breaker
parts.note: Carling CA1-B0-24-615-121-DG: 47.00 mm body depth; 49.28 mm is terminal pitch, not depth. Mounting pitch 52.37 mm; #6-32 inserts, 4.95 mm deep; #10-32 terminal studs. Stud projection is 62.87 minus 47.00 = 15.87 mm from the catalog envelope. One pole, 15 A, 50/60 Hz medium delay. The wall insert, stepped body interface, terminal guard, fault rating and operating duty remain unresolved. See installation audit before ordering or cutting.

parts.name: Fv · voltage-tap fuse holder
parts.status: Catalog dimensions; conflicting SKU data to resolve
parts.note: Bussmann CHCC1DU single Class CC holder candidate; catalog drawing, p.145. Holder rating is not the fuse rating. Select a compatible Class CC fuse only after the voltage leads, fault level and inrush are checked. Verify conductor and tinned-end acceptance; adapt through an approved terminal if necessary. The current Eaton SKU page lists 87 × 73 × 17.5 mm and 48 Vdc, while technical data 10430 lists CHCC1DU at 600 V and a different drawing envelope. Resolve the exact supplied revision with Eaton; the current model is not a purchase release. Fuse-door opening is not modeled.

parts.name: JL / JN / JPE distribution
parts.note: Each WAGO 221-415 body uses the manufacturer CAD dimensions, 29.80 × 8.15 × 18.30 mm. Four carriers provide JL, JN and two bridged PE groups. Final conductor acceptance, PE bonding suitability and capacity for extra metalwork bonds require review. A second PE connector is bridged to the first to provide the outlet-box bond and spare bonding capacity. WAGO 221-505 carrier: 35 × 16.9 × 52.8 mm; M3 DIN 1207 or ST2.9 DIN 7049 fixing, not M4.

parts.name: XA · dedicated adapter outlet
parts.note: Leviton 5261: 27 mm depth, 103.2 mm yoke height, 33.3 mm width. Side-mounted on a supported insulating insert with a RACO rear box and Leviton single-receptacle wallplate. Actual mounting stack, rear wiring and wall thickness still require a dry fit.

parts.name: XA rear box / faceplate
parts.note: RACO 670RAC / retail 8670 handy box. Uses 2.188 in actual depth × 4 in height × 2.125 in width. Leviton 84004-40 faceplate covers the single round receptacle. Metal box/cover need a dedicated PE bond. Wall support, opening and wire-entry fittings are proposed, not fabrication dimensions.

parts.name: Existing two-pin AC/DC adapter
parts.note: Exterior black body is estimated as 65 mm tall × 42 mm wide × 42 mm projection; blades are inside XA. Existing factory cable re-enters via its own entry. Verify the adapter label, plug direction, actual dimensions and retention. No replacement adapter is specified.

parts.name: Short DIN rail · Fv only
parts.note: 35 × 7.5 mm DIN profile, proposed 100 mm cut length for Fv only, with end stops and a dedicated bond. Q0 now mounts on the front panel.

parts.name: Mains / output / data entries
parts.note: Mains cord entries use an approximate Ø27 × 37 mm M20-style envelope; the mains-entry candidate is 1427NCGM20B. Cable outside diameter, wall thickness, sealing and strain relief determine the actual part. USB/DC need an entry that accepts the existing terminated cable; coloured rings mark proposed penetration locations only. KVT 20 split fittings use a conservative 37 mm axial × Ø40 mm flange envelope. USB entry moved to Z=167 mm, leaving about 25.2 mm between split-entry flange edges. Final bore sizes, connector passage, wall thread engagement and tool access remain pending.

parts.name: Blue adapters & retained lead slack
parts.note: Three blue pigtails feed L1 hot, L2 neutral and N neutral. The visible coils reserve space for the full leads; they do not certify storage of each 2 m lead or minimum bend radius. Cable diameters, plug bodies and path lengths are estimates, not a cut list. The separate green conductor is PE. Coil scenario reserves 2 m flexible length per lead at an assumed 3 mm OD, with 4 mm pitch. This does not identify the actual lead length / OD or validate its bend radius, transitions or restraints.

plan.note: Shell bounds are the top-view envelope of enclosure.bin mesh 0; the mounting panel is mesh 33. The plan is a placement reference, not a fabrication template. Terminal symbols are separated for readable connectivity.

instances.label: Retained lead slack
instances.note: Scenario only: each full lead reserves 2000 mm of flexible cable, 3 mm assumed OD, 4 mm helix pitch and 28 mm between lead-layer starts. Actual lengths, diameters, bend limits and transitions must be measured.
